Culture, Community, and Engagement Resources
Culture, Community, and Engagement
Harvard Griffin GSAS and Harvard University offer a number of resources and opportunities dedicated to fostering a welcoming, supportive, and inclusive environment where all graduate students can flourish both academically and personally. Resources are also available for prospective and current graduate students who are first-generation college students or from lower socioeconomic backgrounds.
